prompt: A realistic 1920s photograph on grainy colour film: real people with real skin, pores and stubble. Sprayed over the photograph with aerosol paint: fluorescent pink and acid yellow overspray clouds, hard-edged stencilled halftone shapes and long paint drips running down through the scene, while every face stays real. Camera at waist height from the front of a long bread queue in the snow on a 1920s street at dawn: ordinary people of all ages, men and women, Black, white and South Asian, in worn coats, each holding money, a coin, a fistful, a bag, and at the back a wheelbarrow of notes. Light: grey dawn and one lit shop window full of loaves under a plain blank sign. Plain margins with no writing. Thanks.
